description.value:
Slot none; Price 5,000 gp (lesser), 10,000 gp (normal), 20,000 gp (greater)
Weight 5 lbs.; Feat Cost 1 sp

Increase the DC of magic skill checks to counter or dispel a tenacious talent by 2. If a tenacious talent is dispelled or dismissed, it lasts for 1d4 further rounds (to a maximum of the talents normal duration) before ending (this does not occur if an antimagic field or a similar talent or effect suppresses or ends the talent’s effect without dispelling or dismissing it). The lingering auras of tenacious talents detectable with detect magic last for twice as long as usual after the talent ends.

Construction Requirements
Craft Apparatus, Tenacious Spell; Cost 2,500 gp (lesser), 5,000 gp (normal), 10,000 gp (greater)

Source: Spheres of Power Wiki
description.instructions:
Selected profile: lesser tier; held slender rod. Apply as part of casting a qualifying sphere effect of caster level seven or lower. Hold this apparatus in at least one hand while applying it. Spend one of three daily uses; only one metamagic apparatus may apply per casting. Its feat's extra spell-point and casting-time costs are waived, but normal effect and other-metamagic costs still apply.

Counter/dispel magic-skill DC increases by two only for this talent. After dispelling or dismissal it lingers 1d4 rounds, capped by normal duration; antimagic and similar non-dispel suppression do not trigger this delay. Its lingering detectable aura lasts twice as long after ending.

Shared metamagic apparatus rules. Feat Cost applies to taking the feat, not using the physical apparatus.
